info.title: CIVault API
info.description: Single Owner CI Secrets Manager. JSON requests <=64 KiB; timestamps in responses use Unix seconds, inputs use RFC3339. Responses are no-store. Management APIs never return Key plaintext or configured provider credentials. Unpaginated resource lists suit a single-owner instance.

github_secret.description: Omit to preserve. Empty/masked replacements are rejected.

new_password.description: Revokes all web sessions and admin tokens.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds, UTC; null means no expiry.

path.description: Unique slash-separated path, <=200 UTF-8 bytes. Deleted paths cannot be reused.

value.description: 1–32768 UTF-8 bytes; no NUL. Whitespace is preserved. Never returned to admin callers.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp or explicit null to clear expiry.
Unix seconds, UTC; null means no expiry.
RFC3339 timestamp or explicit null to clear expiry.

workflow_path.description: Exact .github/workflows/name.yml or .yaml, requires repository_id. Checks workflow_ref, not job_workflow_ref or a uses step.

items.description: Exact value; no wildcards. Empty array means unrestricted.
Exact value; no wildcards. Empty array means unrestricted.
Exact value; no wildcards. Empty array means unrestricted.

Rule.description: Exactly one target selector. Tag IDs match ANY current tag. Target and every nonempty workload condition are AND; values and complete policies are OR. No override/deny rules.

token.description: Shown once; only its SHA-256 digest is stored.

sent_at.description: Unix seconds, UTC; null means no expiry.

additionalProperties.description: cv://<workspace_id>/<key-path>; all references must belong to workspace_id. Percent-encode path segments. Case-colliding and reserved names are rejected.
Plaintext UTF-8 value. All requested keys succeed atomically or none are returned.

AdminToken.description: Owner admin token (30 days by default); not a GitHub token.

OwnerSession.name: civault_session
OwnerSession.description: 8 hours. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS. Mutation requires X-CSRF-Token from login/me and same-origin Origin when present.

GithubOIDC.description: GitHub issuer, RS256, official JWKS. Single audience urn:civault:workspace:<workspace_id>. Same JWT can deliver the identical request at most 3 times within 60 seconds; retries pin initial versions and recheck live permissions, tags, expiry and key state.
